column1: # Labels that label_ink_check.R finds crossed by the figure's own ink, and that are left alone,
# with the reason. Anything not on this list is a defect. Written 2026-09-28, when sixteen
# labels were found printed over and thirteen were fixed by moving or masking them.

column3: The label is wider than the interior region is at its height, so the contact geodesic crosses it wherever it sits. A mask was tried and looks worse, because the label straddles the edge of the shaded region and a single-colour patch shows as a box. The crossing line is one thin red geodesic.
Crossed by the dotted midpoint guide at x = 0.5. The label straddles the edge of the shaded right half, so a mask would show as a box, and moving it would take it away from the line it names.
The line crossing it is the arrow drawn from the label to the ring it names, which is what the label is for.
